packageRules.description: Image bumps need the manual checks in AGENTS.md hard rule 2; never automerge
prBodyNotes:
**Before merging (AGENTS.md hard rule 2):**

- [ ] Compare the bundled Collector config with `collector/base.yaml`: `docker run --rm --entrypoint cat "$(docker compose config --images)" /otel-lgtm/otelcol-config.yaml | diff - collector/base.yaml`
- [ ] Confirm the bundled dashboards are still provisioned by `/otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/grafana-dashboards.yaml`
- [ ] `docker compose up -d` and `PROFILE=strict ./scripts/verify.sh` pass
- [ ] Update the version in `collector/base.yaml` (first line) and `docs/design.md` §3
- [ ] Note the result of these checks in this PR
